summary.name: 飞书多维表格 (Feishu Multi-Table)
summary.one_liner: A no-code business-app builder from Feishu (Lark) that combines spreadsheet-style tables with online collaboration, data management, visualization and AI model integration.
use_cases: Building internal business systems without writing code
Managing team project or task tracking data
Turning spreadsheets into shared business applications
Connecting AI models to business data workflows
Setting role-based permissions on shared data
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Feishu Multi-Table as a tool for building enterprise business systems by assembling components, without writing code. It says underlying data is interconnected while top-level permissions are separated, so complex tables can become business applications. It positions itself as an entry point for connecting AI models to business work, citing 200+ AI models and a plugin ecosystem. The meta description adds online collaboration, information management and visualization capabilities. The page itself gives few concrete technical details beyond these claims.
notable: Zero-code business app building from table data
Data interconnected at base level with separated top-level permissions
Claims access to 200+ AI models and a plugin ecosystem
Part of the Feishu (Lark) office suite
caveats: Listed as paid in the source collection (#paid); the page itself does not state specific prices or tiers
Platform support beyond the web is not stated on the page
Customer testimonials are marketing and not verified claims
